text:
elena: Hey team, customer `org_42` just pinged — their trial balance dropped from 10k -> 0 overnight. They say no interactive usage, only a nightly background ingest that calls the embeddings endpoint. Can we confirm if retries or a bug burned tokens?

sahil: Sending logs now. Any chance a scheduled job retried aggressively after an upstream 5xx?

elena: Logs attached (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T02:04:12Z INFO job=vec-sync batch=42 attempt=1 status=500
2026-03-15T02:04:13Z INFO job=vec-sync batch=42 retry=1 backoff_ms=0
2026-03-15T02:04:13Z INFO job=vec-sync batch=42 attempt=2 status=500
2026-03-15T02:04:14Z INFO job=vec-sync batch=42 retry=2 backoff_ms=0
...repeat ~120 times...
2026-03-15T02:06:00Z INFO job=vec-sync batch=42 status=200 tokens_used=18750
```

maya: Whoa — backoff_ms=0 for retries. That looks like a bug where the worker's retry policy got overwritten. Do we have the worker config?

sahil: Found the deploy that rolled last night: `deploy/vec-worker@2026-03-14-23:58` — it included a PR that changed default retry to `0` when `ENV=ci` but env var was mis-set in staging -> prod.

jordan: Best immediate mitigation is to suspend that scheduled job for affected customers and top up trial credits. Support: can we issue a one-time 12k token grant while ops remediates?

support-bot: Ticket #SUP-9876 created for org_42; assigned to @jordan and @elena.

elena: Repro steps I ran locally: 1) run the nightly ingest with `--simulate-500` 2) old worker: exits after 3 retries; new worker: loops until success, no jitter. Patch suggestion below.

maya: Proposed fix (quick patch): set `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES=3` and enable jitter/backoff. Example config snippet: 
```env
EMBED_RETRY_MAX=3
EMBED_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=200
EMBED_RETRY_JITTER=true
```

maya: Also add idempotency keys for batch uploads so repeated retries don't re-charge tokens.

sahil: Ops: here's a query that shows the token burn spike (internal link): https://metrics.redwood/investigations/org_42/vec-spike-2026-03-15

ops-bot: Alert auto-generated: "Embeddings token rate x100 baseline for org_42 between 02:03-02:07 UTC".

jordan: Support has granted a 12k token trial top-up and flagged refund review. I also pushed a temporary rule to cap per-customer embeddings token consumption to 2k/hr for trials.

elena: Thanks. I've scheduled a quick rollback of the worker and will deploy the retry-jitter patch in a hotfix. How should we notify the customer?

support-bot: Suggested message drafted: "We identified a retry loop in our vec-sync worker that caused unexpected token consumption for trial accounts. We've applied a credit, throttled trial ingestion, and deployed a fix. We'll follow up after the postmortem." Want me to send? (yes/no)

jordan: Send it. Also ask if they can share the job config so we can verify idempotency keys.

elena: Patch deployed + rollback completed. Monitoring shows embeddings rate back to normal. Will follow up with full postmortem and an action item to add integration tests for retry behavior.

support-bot: Message sent to org_42.

jordan: Refund review complete — accounting approved the credit; tagging finance to adjust billing for the trial period.

elena: Closing loop here. Follow-ups: 1) add unit/integration test for retry jitter, 2) add idempotency enforcement on batch endpoints, 3) create alert tuned for trial accounts hitting >5k tokens/hr.

maya: I'll own tests and deploy. Thanks everyone :heart:
